meta.description:
A buried Soviet research complex abandoned after a containment failure, its concrete chambers linked by a narrow, dogleg route through failing machinery and sealed laboratories.
    Flickering fluorescent tubes expose rusted control panels, leaking pipes, faded warning paint, and the remnants of experiments hastily left behind.

layout.description:
A buried Soviet research complex abandoned after a containment failure, its concrete chambers linked by a narrow, dogleg route through failing machinery and sealed laboratories.
    Flickering fluorescent tubes expose rusted control panels, leaking pipes, faded warning paint, and the remnants of experiments hastily left behind.

rooms.name: The Decontamination Lock
rooms.style: A cramped entry chamber lined with stained concrete, corroded shower frames, grated drains, and dented steel lockers. Weak fluorescent tubes flicker above faded red quarantine markings.

rooms.name: Conduit Passage 4
rooms.style: A long, oppressive service corridor with exposed pipes, bundled cables, chipped green paint, and intermittent fluorescent fixtures. Rusted junction boxes and low maintenance carts constrict the route.

rooms.name: Red Dynamo Hall
rooms.style: A broad machine chamber dominated by massive turbine housings, ceramic insulators, overhead ducts, and rust-streaked control cabinets. Black oil pools around cracked concrete plinths beneath dim red emergency lamps.

rooms.name: The Silent Operations Gallery
rooms.style: A tall command room filled with angled banks of rusted analog controls, dead radar displays, rotary telephones, and a central plotting table. Faded crimson banners hang behind shattered observation windows.

rooms.name: The Black Records Cage
rooms.style: A narrow archival chamber packed with steel shelving, warped document boxes, reel-to-reel tapes, and locked mesh cabinets. A single buzzing tube casts hard shadows through drifting dust.
